name: agent-reliability
description: Stops unproductive retry loops: blocks a test/build that already failed the same way with nothing changed (Rule B), refuses to resend refused calls and never works around a user denial (Rule C), escalates after failed recovery attempts (Rule A), and optionally asks TypeSafe Jev for the next recovery step from the 2nd failure (Jev Recovery Advisor: off / shadow / apply). Observe mode by default; AGENT_RELIABILITY=off is the kill switch.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe (log only), enforce (deny), or off. Env AGENT_RELIABILITY and /reliability override it.

ruleB.title: Rule B: block identical repeats
ruleB.description: In enforce mode, deny a repeat of a verification that failed the same way with nothing changed.

ruleA.title: Rule A: recovery budget + Opus escalation
ruleA.description: In enforce mode, deny the next verification after maxRecoveryStrategies failed attempts and ask for the Opus recovery agent; then NEEDS_USER. Off: logged only.

maxRecoveryStrategies.title: Recovery strategies before escalation
maxRecoveryStrategies.description: Failed reruns that followed a change (edit, mutating command) on one incident.

maxIdenticalFailuresBeforeBlock.title: Identical failures before block
maxIdenticalFailuresBeforeBlock.description: Same action + same error + no change, this many times, then the next repeat is blocked.

failureRecordTtlMinutes.title: Record TTL (minutes)
failureRecordTtlMinutes.description: Older failures and incidents never block.

maxRecordsPerSession.title: Max records
maxRecordsPerSession.description: Bound on failure records kept per session.

gitTimeoutMs.title: Git state budget (ms)
gitTimeoutMs.description: Total time for the git content token; over budget = unknown = allow.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: JSONL decisions to <telemetry folder>/<session>.jsonl (no tool output).

telemetryDir.title: Telemetry folder
telemetryDir.description: Absolute folder for the JSONL files. Empty = telemetry/ inside this plugin's own folder.

dumpRaw.title: Diagnostics dump
dumpRaw.description: Phase 0 only: filtered result fields to diag-<session>.jsonl. Leave off.

jevEnabled.title: Ask JEV on near-duplicates
jevEnabled.description: Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY; errors and timeouts allow.

jevTimeoutMs.title: JEV timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: Decision budget; on timeout the call is allowed.

jevMinConfidence.title: JEV min confidence
jevMinConfidence.description: block_redundant_retry must reach this probability to block.

mainAgentOnly.title: Main agent only
mainAgentOnly.description: Leave subagent verification calls alone (subagents are tracked separately when off).

extraEligible.title: Extra eligible commands
extraEligible.description: Comma-separated command prefixes treated as tests.

ruleC.title: Rule C: refusal loops
ruleC.description: In enforce mode, deny resending a call the harness refused, and any retry of an action the user denied (by another tool, shell or path) until /reliability allow lifts it.

jevAdvisor.title: Jev Recovery Advisor
jevAdvisor.description: off: no call. shadow: from the 2nd consecutive failure, ask TypeSafe Jev for one of 5 recovery actions and log it only. apply (enforce mode): carry the decision out inside the core limits. shadow/apply send a redacted incident summary (commands, short error text, no file contents) to TypeSafe Jev via OpenRouter (needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY) and cost money per call.

jevAdvisorMinConfidence.title: Jev advisor min probability
jevAdvisorMinConfidence.description: next_step must reach this probability to be applied; below it the v0.2 behaviour stays.

includePromptInJev.title: Send the user prompt to Jev
includePromptInJev.description: Adds the last user prompt (redacted, 300 chars) to the advisor request. Off by default.

datasetCapture.title: Local failure dataset
datasetCapture.description: One sanitized line per failed attempt, refusal, Jev decision and incident end to attempts-YYYY-MM.jsonl (no tool output, no file contents, no prompt). Local only.

datasetDir.title: Dataset folder
datasetDir.description: Absolute folder for attempts-YYYY-MM.jsonl. Empty = ~/.claude/agent-reliability/dataset (outside the plugin and the repo).
